newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 264 OF OCTOBER 17, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 264 OF OCTOBER 17, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COMMISSION DECISION of 14 October 1996 on the list of programmes for the eradication and monitoring of animal diseases qualifying for a financial contribution from the Community in 1997 (96/598/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 14 October 1996 on the list of programmes of checks aimed at the prevention of zoonoses qualifying for a financial contribution from the Community in 1997 (96/597/EC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1988/96 of 16 October 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1987/96 of 16 October 1996 determining the extent to which applications lodged in October 1996 for import licences for certain milk products and products covered by the arrangements provided for in the Europe Agreements concluded by the Community with the Republic of Poland, the Republic of Hungary, the Czech Republic and the Slovak Republic can be accepted

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1986/96 of 16 October 1996 determining the extent to which applications lodged in October 1996 for import certificates for certain cheeses covered by the arrangements provided for in the Europe Agreements concluded by the Community with Bulgaria and Romania can be accepted

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1985/96 of 16 October 1996 fixing Community producer prices for carnations and roses for the application of the import arrangements for certain floricultural products originating in Cyprus, Israel, Jordan and Morocco

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1984/96 of 16 October 1996 amending Regulation (EEC) No 2165/92 laying down detailed rules for the application of the specific measures for Madeira and the Azores as regards potatoes and endives
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1983/96 of 16 October 1996 establishing unit values for the determination of the customs value of certain perishable goods
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1982/96 of 16 October 1996 fixing the representative prices and the additional import duties for molasses in the sugar sector

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1981/96 of 16 October 1996 fixing the maximum export refund for white sugar for the 11th partial invitation to tender issued within the framework of the standing invitation to tender provided for in Regulation (EC) No 1464/96
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1980/96 of 16 October 1996 altering the export refunds on white sugar and raw sugar exported in the natural state END OF DOCUMENT.
